AN ORDINANCE PURSUANT TO TOWN CHARTER OF THE TOWN OF CLERMONT, GEORGIA, TO ESTABLISH REGULATIONS GOVERNING YARD SALES.

WHEREAS, the Town Council of the Town of Clermont, Georgia, is authorized by

Yard Sale inside the corporate town limits of the Town of Clermont, Georgia as appropriate;

WHEREAS, due to unregulated yard sales by some residents of the Town of Clermont, the Town Council finds that it would be appropriate for the Town Council to set regulations for yard sales;

NOW, THEREFORE, be it ordained by the Town Council of the Town of Clermont, Georgia, pursuant to Section 2-403 of the Town Charter, and it is hereby ordained by the authority of same, as follows: |

YARD SALE “Yard sale” means sales of used household belongings by an individual at his principal residence or by a group of individuals combining such items for a group yard sale at one of their principal residences. Such sales may be held no more than four times in a calendar year,

with each individual sale lasting no more than three consecutive days. All merchandise must be the property of the person(s) holding the sale and not be purchased for the purpose of resale. The term also includes garage sales, basement sales, or other similar usage. Such sales are exempt from the screening requirements of section 17.260.010. All other sales of merchandise are considered as inventory subject to the screening requirements of section 17.260.010.

EFFECTIVE DATE This ordinance is hereby adopted and effective upon passage by the Town Council of the

Town of Clermont, Georgia, the public health, safety and general welfare demanding it.

REPEAL OF CONFLICTING ORDINANCES Any and all prior ordinances, or any parts thereof, that are in conflict with this ordinance, are repealed to the extent of the conflict.
